title: LCLI-718 review minors: split the (a3) lifecycle proofs per case, pin sourceLoads on the fresh-tree proof, and correct two cli-surface.md claims
description:
The three non-blocking findings from the opus round-3 review of opum-ai/lore-cli#725 (VERDICT APPROVE at ea0fd244744208941121a1d8d1c6265afd8f438c). The build landed as squash d0601bfccbc2d1ee7e8203ee1ccb7935489438d1 with CI run 44424067971 green on the reviewed head. None of these changes a behaviour the ruling governs; they are proof quality and documentation accuracy.

F1 (test quality). test/ladybug-lifecycle.test.ts runs its inspector-mode loop inside one test() at lines 298, 322, 345 and 374, and the writable-file case loop nests inside it at 322. A mutation run therefore shows only the FIRST red row and hides whether the other cases still pass, which is exactly the predicted-subset evidence the mutation rule asks for. Use test.each or describe.each so each mode and each case reports its own red or green.

F2 (coverage gap). test/ladybug-lifecycle.test.ts:311 asserts only that the fresh-tree proof reused the generation; it does not assert sourceLoads. Coverage of that assertion exists elsewhere (about line 274 and line 407), but one sourceLoads line here would pin that this specific proof hit the fast path rather than rebuilding it.

F4 (documentation accuracy). docs/reference/cli-surface.md:717-718 says a generation published by (a3) or later keeps its directory owner-writable and so needs no clearing, while :725 calls cache clear the first step of worktree removal. The two are reconcilable only if the docstring wording is matched — src/core/ladybug-lifecycle.ts:477 says it needs no thaw AND this still clears it. Separately, the phrase published by (a3) or later names a RULING where a RELEASE is meant; a consumer cannot publish a generation by a decision, only by a lore version that carries it. Narrow the wording to the release, keeping the pre-(a3) and mixed-version cases as they are.

acceptanceCriteria.text: test/ladybug-lifecycle.test.ts runs the inspector-mode permutations at lines 298, 322, 345 and 374 and the writable-file cases through test.each or describe.each, so a mutation shows each failing case rather than only the first (F1).
The fresh-tree proof at test/ladybug-lifecycle.test.ts:311 asserts sourceLoads alongside the reuse assertion, so a fast-path miss cannot read as a successful rebuild (F2).

docs/reference/cli-surface.md:717-718 matches the src/core/ladybug-lifecycle.ts:477 docstring (needs no thaw, and this still clears it) and names a lore RELEASE rather than an (a3) ruling where a version is meant (F4).
